name: Ivan
summary: Ivan is an Expert Advisor that identifies breakout opportunities by detecting price movement beyond defined support and resistance levels. It enters trades when price breaks through key levels with momentum confirmation and manages positions with trailing stops. The EA uses a combination of volatility filtering and time-based session analysis to avoid false breakouts.
summary_zh: Ivan是一个通过检测价格突破支撑和阻力水平来识别突破机会的智能交易系统。它在价格伴随动量确认突破关键水平时入场，并使用追踪止损管理仓位。该EA结合波动率过滤和时段分析来避免假突破。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略是基于价格突破支撑和阻力水平进行交易。入场条件为价格突破前N根K线的高低点，并配合成交量或动量指标确认突破有效性。出场条件包括固定止盈止损以及追踪止损机制，确保利润锁定。仓位管理采用固定手数或基于账户余额的百分比计算方式。资金管理方面使用了最大回撤控制和单日最大亏损限制。策略还包含时段过滤，避免在低流动性时段交易。
strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA is based on trading price breakouts beyond support and resistance levels. Entry conditions require price to break above the high or below the low of the previous N candles, with momentum or volume confirmation to validate the breakout. Exit conditions include fixed take-profit and stop-loss levels as well as a trailing stop mechanism to lock in profits. Position sizing uses either fixed lot sizes or a percentage-based calculation tied to account equity. Money management incorporates maximum drawdown controls and daily loss limits to protect capital. The strategy also includes session filtering to avoid trading during low-liquidity periods that produce false breakouts.
pros: 突破策略逻辑清晰，顺势交易胜率较高
具备追踪止损机制，能有效锁定浮动利润
包含时段过滤和点差过滤，避免不利交易环境
pros_en: Clear breakout logic with trend-following approach yields relatively high win rates
Trailing stop mechanism effectively locks in floating profits
Session and spread filtering avoids unfavorable trading conditions
cons: 突破策略在震荡行情中容易产生连续假突破亏损
缺少多时间周期确认，单一周期突破信号可靠性有限
仓位管理较为简单，未考虑波动率自适应调仓
cons_en: Breakout strategy tends to generate consecutive false breakout losses in ranging markets
Lacks multi-timeframe confirmation, reducing reliability of single-timeframe breakout signals
Position sizing is simplistic without volatility-adaptive adjustments
improvements: 增加多时间周期确认机制，提高突破信号可靠性
引入ATR动态止损止盈，适应不同波动环境
improvements_en: Add multi-timeframe confirmation to improve breakout signal reliability
Introduce ATR-based dynamic stop-loss and take-profit to adapt to varying volatility environments

risk_points: 单一周期突破在震荡市中可能连续触发亏损
缺少持仓数量限制，极端行情下可能过度暴露
追踪止损参数固定，高波动时可能过早被扫出
risk_points_en: Single-timeframe breakout may trigger consecutive losses in ranging markets
Lacks maximum position count limit, risking overexposure in extreme conditions
Fixed trailing stop parameter may cause premature exits during high volatility
